WhatsApp rolls out bill payment feature in India

WhatsApp has launched a bill payment feature in India, allowing users to pay utility bills directly through the app. The feature enables payments for services such as electricity, water, and gas. Users can access the feature within the WhatsApp app and set it up by following on-screen instructions. This expansion aims to integrate more financial services into the messaging platform.
